title: Amrum  (KINO)
synopsis: On the remote island of Amrum in spring 1945, 12-year-old Nanning braves treacherous seas for seal hunting, fishes through the night, and tends the fields to keep his family alive. But as long-awaited peace finally arrives, unforeseen challenges compel him to chart his own course through the turbulent waters of post-war life. From one of Germany's leading directors, Fatih Akin, and inspired by the real childhood memories of acclaimed screenwriter Hark Bohm, AMRUM is a sweeping, deeply moving story of resilience and self-discovery. Premiered at Cannes 2025 and received 6 nominations at the German Film Awards.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 1945年，德國偏遠小島阿姆魯姆島，二次大戰步入尾聲，男孩南寧過著簡單寧靜的日子。生活看似無風無浪，背後卻處處暗湧。懷孕了的媽媽視希特拉為民族英雄，爸爸則慘成戰俘歸家無期。當收音機傳來希特拉身亡納粹倒台消息，南寧的生活隨即出現巨變，大受打擊的媽媽只肯吃牛油蜜糖白麵包，南寧為此到小島對岸為媽媽尋找食材，展開一段難忘旅程。德國名導法提阿金從小孩的角度出發，側寫戰爭對人性的衝擊，散發人文關懷。電影入圍2025年康城影展，並獲德國電影獎六項提名。
